blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Guildford. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Guildford, Surrey: 49 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 4%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 12 of 15 Surrey communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Guildford rose from 37 in June to 49 in September (+32.4%), and 15 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 4.4% of Surrey’s 1,120 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Guildford?
Guildford also had 161 condos and townhomes listed and 12 sold in September, against 49 houses listed.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Guildford?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 49 houses listed in Guildford. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Guildford a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Guildford had a sales ratio of 4%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Guildford from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 15 houses sold in Guildford over those 4 months, out of 351 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Guildford?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
